lines.text: The LORD tells Ezekiel to prophesy against the mountains of Israel and says He will bring a sword.
God says the altars will be demolished, the slain laid before their idols, and the cities laid waste.
Some will escape the sword, and survivors carried captive to Egypt will remember the LORD and loathe themselves.
God tells Ezekiel to clap his hands and stomp his feet because Israel will fall by sword, famine and plague.
God will stretch out His hand and make the land a desolate waste from the wilderness to Beersheba.
